title: Two fingers
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Thursday. Maria checks the dog's leg with two fingers. She's done it for years. This time she keeps them there a beat longer and looks at Wood, and the strip draws the beat.

panels.composition: Gully's. BARNABY in the basket on the counter. MARIA's two fingers on his hind leg. WOOD on the stool. GULLY behind.

panels.composition: The two fingers. Held. A beat longer than usual.

panels.composition: Maria looking at Wood. The look. Not the head-shake — that's for Gully. This one's new.

panels.composition: Maria's hand off the leg, onto Wood's forearm, once, and gone to the register. Gully looking at the counter. The dog asleep in the basket.
